result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.contract_nodes_multi()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Contract multiple nodes into a single node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L11857-L11924){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.contract_nodes_multi( nodes, self_loops=True, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Merges all specified nodes into the first node in the list. All edges incident to any of the contracted nodes are redirected to the first node. Edges between contracted nodes become self-loops (if `self_loops=True`). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs or labels to contract. The first node is the target; all other nodes are merged into it. [self_loops]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True` (default), edges between contracted nodes become self-loops. If `False`, such edges are removed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new graph with all specified nodes contracted into one. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any node does not exist. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the node list is empty. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - time complexity: `O(k * E)` where `k` is number of nodes to contract - the first node in the list retains its ID and attributes - all other nodes are removed from the graph ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#39063d2e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_path_graph(6) # 1 -- 2 -- 3 -- 4 -- 5 -- 6 result = g.contract_nodes_multi([2, 3, 4]) result.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 4 ``` ::: ::: This is especially useful for collapsing an entire detected community down to a single representative node: ::: {#8eef2e5f .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_path_graph(10) membership = g.cmty_louvain(return_dict=True) community_0 = [n for n, c in membership.items() if c == 0] simplified = g.contract_nodes_multi(community_0) if len(community_0) > 1 else g simplified.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 9 ``` ::: :::
